A Journey Home#001.src: Explore near where you originally arrived in Wynn.

A Journey Home#003.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.

A Journey Home#004.src: This job is impossible!! Why am I even here?!
A Journey Home#004.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#005.src: Ah! You're a soldier, right? Look, I It's, it's just a really difficult time right now.
A Journey Home#005.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#006.src: This, this whole situation is definitely above my paygrade! I don't know how I'm going to deal with this...
A Journey Home#006.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#007.src: Enough of that, I, ah, I suppose. What is it you need?
A Journey Home#007.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#008.src: Oh. Oh no. Ah, I, you see, that'll be a problem, I think. What do you even need to do at the border anyway?
A Journey Home#008.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#009.src: I can't really imagine what you could need there, but, whatever it is, it'll need to wait! This Corkian drill won't work, and Paxon's stuck, and
A Journey Home#009.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#010.src: Look, I'm...I'm sorry for snapping at you. I'm trained for military operation, not for cave-in clearance, but no one else was available!
A Journey Home#010.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#011.src: Even the demolitions expert I hired is stuck, so it's all just, it's all going wrong and I don't know what to do.
A Journey Home#011.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#012.src: You see that new entrance over there? The expert, Paxon, has been in there for almost as long as I was trying this dud machine.
A Journey Home#012.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#013.src: If you think you can do a job better than an expert, go ahead and talk with them, but I'm pretty sure you'll have to cancel whatever plans you had.
A Journey Home#013.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#014.src: Talk to the Demolition Mage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Journey Home#015.src: If you really need to get to the border, your best bet is to talk to Paxon in the new cave entrance.
A Journey Home#015.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#016.src: But, they're an expert, so I think your business will have to wait. Really, really sorry about all this!
A Journey Home#016.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#017.src: Oh no, not another one I don't care what rank you are, what you're asking is impossible! Even for me, it
A Journey Home#017.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#018.src: Wait, you aren't part of the... You're just a regular soldier. You're just trying to get through here, aren't you?
A Journey Home#018.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#019.src: May as well give up now! Not happening. No way. You're wasting your time, and let me tell you exactly why.
A Journey Home#019.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#020.src: You see that blue rock over there? It's a break point. If I could set off explosives at it, it'd open a path.
A Journey Home#020.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#021.src: But apparently all these structures set up are so important that any of it being damaged, or MOVED, is unacceptable!
A Journey Home#021.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#022.src: And to make sure I'm 'supervised' while the lieutenant is working on the drill, the detonator HAS to be here.
A Journey Home#022.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#023.src: So I have to daisy-chain a limited amount of explosives all the way over to the stone, without blasting any structures!
A Journey Home#023.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#024.src: I've been trying for hours and gotten absolutely nowhere! I'm one of the best in my field, even! It's ridiculous!!
A Journey Home#024.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#025.src: If you feel like wasting your time, here's my stock of explosives. Feel free to try your hand at it, but you really should just go.
A Journey Home#025.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#026.src: Use the TNT to open up a path through the cave.

A Journey Home#027.src: Still at it? What, do you need a reminder? I've got nothing better to do.
A Journey Home#027.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#028.src: So the blue rock is soft enough to crack with the explosives. But the detonator's stuck here.
A Journey Home#028.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#029.src: So we need to use the TNT Placer to daisy-chain blasts from the detonator, without blasting any tents, crates, or walls.
A Journey Home#029.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#030.src: You can look at placed TNT to see its blast radius, as well.
A Journey Home#030.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#031.src: But given how tight the squeeze between some of those structures is, there's just no way it's happening.
A Journey Home#031.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#032.src: Like I said, you really should just mosey on back to the castle. If I can't get anywhere, I don't think you'll fare better.
A Journey Home#032.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#035.src: Halt! Where did you come from? There was a cave-in past here, wasn't there?
A Journey Home#035.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#036.src: A new path, huh? I didn't think you'd have things to be doing back here, though I won't say I'm ungrateful.
A Journey Home#036.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#037.src: It even crushed the grook's nest there. I've been working off field rations for a few days. So where are you headed?
A Journey Home#037.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#038.src: The border? I suppose if you're headed there, it must be important, official business. Although, it might have to wait.
A Journey Home#038.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#039.src: The bridge repair was something of a hackjob. It may not bear up your weight. Now that the cave-in's clear, we might be able to get it fixed proper...
A Journey Home#039.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#040.src: But that'll take time. I'd just as soon turn back whatever business you have isn't worth your life, after all.
A Journey Home#040.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#042.src: Say, I think I recognize you, actually. That's a rarity for this line of work.
A Journey Home#042.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#043.src: Are you sure that what you have to do is worth it? That bridge is awful rickety. Wouldn't want to lose you.
A Journey Home#043.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#044.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.

A Journey Home#045.src: Hey, you there! Come talk to me before you pass through.
A Journey Home#045.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#046.src: Hey, you! Come talk to me first, recruit!
A Journey Home#046.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#047.src: Coming or going, I'm under strict orders to intercept soldiers and make sure they're equipped before heading on.
A Journey Home#047.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#048.src: No exceptions, not for any reason. Especially not since the cave-in across the river!
A Journey Home#048.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#049.src: Nothing's more important than your life, and moving on without being suited up could cost you it!
A Journey Home#049.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#050.src: Well, let me take a look and see if this stuff is up to regulation.
A Journey Home#050.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#051.src: Hmm... Ah, yep, signs of wear all over... Armor not polished... Weapon looks liable to fall apart any second...
A Journey Home#051.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#052.src: I'm surprised you made it ten feet out here with those rusty trinkets! This is no way to protect yourself!
A Journey Home#052.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#053.src: Look, there's a loot chest in the cave just there, so you need to head in and get yourself some proper equipment.
A Journey Home#053.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#054.src: ...that so, huh? Well, I think you should take a second look up ahead.
A Journey Home#054.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#055.src: See? Now no more guff about levels you either gear up properly, or you don't pass! I won't have you risking your life.
A Journey Home#055.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#056.src: You can find good stuff in caves, like the one just next to me, so hop to it.
A Journey Home#056.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#057.src: Like I said, coming or going. No matter what, you should gear up by looting the cave here before heading onwards.
A Journey Home#057.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#058.src: Good stuff. There's a loot chest in that cave there, so you should find everything you need. Get to it!
A Journey Home#058.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#059.src: Explore the cave to find some loot.

A Journey Home#060.src: Enter the cave and open the loot chest.
A Journey Home#060.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#061.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.

A Journey Home#062.src: That looks like the stuff. You can take that armor to an Item Identifier right there, and then you can wear it once identified.
A Journey Home#062.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#063.src: Though... since you seem to be heading back to the border... I have to ask why. It's pretty unusual. Probably best you head back to {p}.
A Journey Home#063.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#064.src: If other recruits see you coming the other way, they might get confused, or discouraged. Wouldn't want to risk that, right?
A Journey Home#064.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#065.src: Are you sure whatever you're doing is worth it? Maybe you should just head back to town.
A Journey Home#065.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#066.src: Avoid the Fruman recruits on the path.

A Journey Home#067.src: ...been recruiting Fruman soldiers for the war effort. Apparently things are really bad over there. Makes me nervous...
A Journey Home#067.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#068.src: Walking corpses aren't anything I'm going to underestimate, but it can't be all doom and gloom, right?
A Journey Home#068.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#069.src: I suppose we'll see once we pass this gate. It marks the border... Deep breaths, deep breaths...
A Journey Home#069.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#070.src: ...know anything about Wynn? I didn't get any debriefing.
A Journey Home#070.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#071.src: I remember rumors... Something about a great hero. Name started with...and R?
A Journey Home#071.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#072.src: We'll make it a point to ask as soon as we can. Information's key to fighting wars.
A Journey Home#072.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#073.src: ...rotten driver. I feel for the man, but he said he always hits that boulder. Sounds like his own fault to me.
A Journey Home#073.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#074.src: I'm thinking about meals more than wheels. I feel like I haven't eaten in days. Hope the walk's short...
A Journey Home#074.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#075.src: Well, if he was a more competent driver you wouldn't have to walk so far on an empty stomach! Let's hurry so we can get you a feast, huh?
A Journey Home#075.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#076.src: Wait, who's that? Why are they coming from the border??
A Journey Home#076.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#078.src: ...and that's the last of them for today.
A Journey Home#078.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#079.src: Lots of pairs today. Eight more in the wings... But that's for tomorrow.
A Journey Home#079.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#080.src: Same darn boulder... Same darn line, too. Wonder if they'll let me shake it up one day. This is always a pain...
A Journey Home#080.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#081.src: And that's that about that. And now, to be off...to the home I choose. And there's no troubles to follow me there.
A Journey Home#081.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#083.src: Just couldn't take the hint, huh?
A Journey Home#083.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#084.src: Bet you think you're slick. Didn't even notice me hang back to watch, huh? I wasn't born yesterday.
A Journey Home#084.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#085.src: Listen, this isn't the first time something like this has happened Y'know. Someone gets curious, retraces their steps.
A Journey Home#085.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#086.src: If you couldn't tell, this whole thing's meant to be a one way trip. The bridge, the cave-in, everyone trying to discourage you.
A Journey Home#086.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#087.src: It's not wise to be here After all, you weren't the one out of your group of three that got permission to stay. Yeah, I heard about the tournament results.
A Journey Home#087.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#088.src: So...you got two choices, buddy. We can let this slide between us. We can. You can go marching back to {p} and my lips will be sealed.
A Journey Home#088.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#089.src: Or, you can live life dangerously and follow me on the train to {p}. Better make your choice quick, though it's leaving soon.
A Journey Home#089.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#090.src: If I see you in the passenger cabin, well...that'll be that, and you'll just have to wait and see what comes of it.
A Journey Home#090.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#091.src: Join the Caravan Driver in the passenger car at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Journey Home#092.src: Last chance to back out. This your choice?
A Journey Home#092.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#093.src: Well, you better get headed on the long walk back to {p} then.
A Journey Home#093.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#097.src: You know what they say about curiosity, and how it killed the cat. You the type to believe satisfaction'll bring it back?
A Journey Home#097.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#098.src: Well, 'kittycat,' you didn't find the cream just the hound dogs.
A Journey Home#098.speaker: Fruman Guard

A Journey Home#099.src: Intruder to Fruma, you are under arrest! Now march!
A Journey Home#099.speaker: Fruman Guard

A Journey Home#100.src: You really thought the Driver was on your side, intruder? What a fool you are. We gave you every chance to quit this endeavor, but here you are. Let's go.
A Journey Home#100.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#102.src: I have urgent news to report from the gate.
A Journey Home#102.speaker: Guard Captain

A Journey Home#103.src: If it is truly so urgent, let's speak.
A Journey Home#103.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#104.src: Soldiers! Keep the intruder still. I've every faith in you.
A Journey Home#104.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#108.src: Anythin' I can help you with?
A Journey Home#108.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#109.src: Hm. Suppose there's no harm. But watch yourself, alright?
A Journey Home#109.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#110.src: This here's our home. I wouldn't take too kindly to you messin' anything up, understand?
A Journey Home#110.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#111.src: ...doin' alright, all things considered. Weather's nice, I suppose. Festival comin' up.
A Journey Home#111.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#112.src: But that ain't none of our business, really. If you didn't need anythin' else, I'll kindly ask you to take your leave.
A Journey Home#112.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#113.src: Hm. Good. Have a nice day, now.
A Journey Home#113.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#114.src: Hmm? And who may you be?
A Journey Home#114.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#115.src: Hoh, oh well. Might I help you with something?
A Journey Home#115.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#116.src: Ah, completing some assorted metalworking projects. There always seems to be something to replace or maintain around here...
A Journey Home#116.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#117.src: Though, I certainly am no expert! But I can handle the tools well enough, and that is all that is needed for the task.
A Journey Home#117.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#118.src: Farewell, stranger! I hope that you will return home safely.
A Journey Home#118.speaker: Mora
